item.title: How Europe's Leading Research Institutes Are Integrating AI — And What It Means for Your Organisation
item.description:
A strategic overview of how six major European research institutes — CERN, Helmholtz, Fraunhofer, EMBL-EBI, ESA, and Max Planck — have moved from AI strategy to operational deployment. Covers governance structures, confirmed tools in use, and the implementation signals most relevant to other organisations. Published on The Science Talk.
